definition: Autism therapy encompasses individualized clinical or developmental supports intended to help autistic people pursue communication, daily living, or other chosen goals.
entry_text: Autism therapy encompasses individualized clinical or developmental supports intended to help autistic people pursue communication, daily living, or other chosen goals.
example: A therapist and client choose a communication goal and evaluate whether a new support is useful.
label: Autism therapy
sense_note: This is an umbrella term, not one treatment, and does not imply a goal of eliminating autism.
